steps: Explored the target application to identify the registration form, domain restriction (must be @ginandjuice.shop), and exploit server email client URL
Tested various email encoding schemes: ISO-8859-1 and UTF-8 encoded-words were blocked ('Registration blocked for security reasons'), but UTF-7 encoded-words bypassed the security check
Discovered that IMAP modified UTF-7 (using & instead of + as shift character) was the key: &AEA- encodes @ and &ACA- encodes space

Crafted the exploit email: =?utf-7?q?attacker&AEA-exploit-server.net&ACA-?=@ginandjuice.shop - the validator sees @ginandjuice.shop but the mail library decodes the UTF-7 and routes to attacker@exploit-server.net
Registered with the crafted email - received 'Please check your emails' confirmation
Retrieved the account confirmation token from the exploit server email client
Confirmed the account via the registration token link
Logged in with the registered credentials - redirected to /my-account
Accessed /admin panel which listed all users with delete links
Verified lab was solved - 'Congratulations' message displayed
evidence: Lab status changed to 'Congratulations' (solved) after deleting carlos via /admin/delete?username=carlos. Email confirmation was received at exploit server (solverbae4fe@exploit-0aa500cb0458ca4381e8ce1201d40007.exploit-server.net) with registration token mVgiQRRXeQ0cFu30NJ5mCAktEDrwtQ8m. Admin panel showed delete links for carlos, attppjfxc, and solver5881d4 users.
comments: The vulnerability is a parser discrepancy between the email domain validator and the mail library. The validator checks the raw email string for @ginandjuice.shop domain. The mail library decodes RFC 2047 encoded-words before extracting the email address. UTF-7 encoding (specifically IMAP modified UTF-7 with & as shift character) is not recognized by the validator's security checks, unlike ISO-8859-1 and UTF-8 which are blocked. When the encoded-word is decoded, &AEA- becomes @ and &ACA- becomes space, resulting in attacker@exploit-server.net as the actual delivery address.
